system.description:
Wretched Unchosen. Cultivations: You start with the following spread: ✦✦✦✦ (4), ✦✦✦ (3), ✦✦ (2), ✦✦ (2), ✦ (1), ✦ (1) Gear: Start with 1 melee or ranged weapon (6+d6 ammo). Then gain a [COMMON] or [UNCOMMON] Fashion. Trait: Choose 1 from the Trait list

Before applying this Job: assign 4, 3, 2, 2, 1, 1 to the six Cultivations and add one chosen weapon, one Common/Uncommon Fashion and one Trait to its loadout. For a ranged weapon roll 6+d6 ammunition and set its ammo quantity. The six 1s are unassigned placeholders; this template cannot be applied until customized.

Laborer Toil to earn the right to live. VIO✦✦✦✦DIA✦GRC✦SAV✦✦✦WRD✦✦SPI✦✦ [R HAND] Workhammer (Bludgeon) [FASHION] Working Class Clothes (+1 Armor. +1 to all Checks dealing with courage, bravery, or staying steadfast. All forced movement are reduced by 1.) [TRAIT] Adamance (+1 Max Health)

Laborer Toil to earn the right to live. VIO✦✦✦✦DIA✦GRC✦SAV✦✦✦WRD✦✦SPI✦✦ [R HAND] Workhammer (Bludgeon) [FASHION] Working Class Clothes (+1 Armor. +1 to all Checks dealing with courage, bravery, or staying steadfast. All forced movement are reduced by 1.) [TRAIT] Adamance (+1 Max Health)

ARMOR +1 ARDOR +0 +1 to all Checks dealing with courage, bravery, or staying steadfast; all forced movement are reduced by 1. A ragged shirt, headwrap and wide-brimmed straw hat, some light pants and leather boots or rubber slippers. Just enough to get by.

Ignore damage so you can soldier on, until the bittermost end. Those that have developed this to the extreme become demon carapace warriors in the front lines of the war against heaven, led by the Warrior Demon Dyakemban. Gain +[Level] max Health.

At the heart of every sentient being is the Beast writhing. The purest expression of the prima materia of all life: the Void. Break doors, chains, bones. Laugh at the weak. The grand Jetung Opera, the crux of Jeng and Jaxiya. Don the pheasant helmets, the ogre masks, the armor-costumes and dance in light and shadow. Operatics are true performers and masters of the art, but this requires an almost lifetime worth of investment to achieve. More importantly, many dances are used for combat, and vice versa. +[Level] dice to any GRC Check to leap, vault, climb, or maneuver. Add +1 die to any movement-based performance. You can recreate any motion you have performed before.

Everyone can be beautiful. Not everyone can commit to it, or is a natural at it. This cultivation has you practicing facial movements, perfecting makeup, and performing rituals for face-shapings to attain final beauty. Beauty is an armor. And all armor weighs on you. +[Level] dice to any Check that leverages your appearance to persuade, charm, or influence. You cannot remain unnoticed in a crowd—people remember your face.

ARMOR 0 ARDOR +2 All attempts to deduce, anal yze, or research something gain +2. Light robes with talisman geometries scrawled across it. Leather dress shoes, a nice beret or hat or some glasses. Clothes for those that cannot sleep at night, chasing after the great mysteries of the Trichiliocosm.

Not everyone has what it takes to be a revolutionary. An ideology that arose from Kafeng Masangwa and the Shennin Commune, which was summarily destroyed even after they successfully conducted the First World Revolution against the Invincible Blade Princess. They dared to think different: no wages, no rulers, no middlemen. A society that loves humanity. It failed, but they did try. To be a communist still is to be someone of a vajra-will and vajra-intelligence, to find the stars in the darkness. +[Level] die to DIA Checks analyzing social structures (Pessimism of the Intellect). +[Level] die to SPI Checks resisting coercion or despair (Optimism of the Will). However, you gain -[Level] dice when attempting to carouse or chill with others: all your theory is scaring off the studs and the huzz.
